TownTex01.usage: Tekstury miasteczka-bazaru (źródło map do barwienia TownMap_*)
TownTex01.notes: kafelek 1/16 arkusza 4x4 z Higgsfield (nano_banana_2_1, 4k, referencje: arkusz v2 sali i KeyArt_ref), 25.11.2026, D-147; świadomie bez stałego początku Glossy Ink (cienka brązowa kreska jak arkusz v2 sali); prompt w TownTex01
TownTex01.prompt:
Texture sheet for a cartoon 3D game town, painted in exactly the same hand-drawn cartoon style as the attached reference texture sheet (first image) and the "Blocky & Crycket" key art (second image): soft painterly cel-shading, thin warm dark-brown outlines (not thick black ink), gentle soft highlights, no halftone dots, no cracks unless asked, friendly saturated but soft colours. Layout: a 4 x 4 grid of 16 equal square tiles separated by even white gaps. Every tile is a flat, straight-on, edge-to-edge seamless repeating material swatch that completely fills its square: no frame, no border, no rounded corners, no vignette, no perspective, no objects, no shadows from outside; the pattern must tile seamlessly left-right and top-bottom. Row 1, left to right: (1) short cartoon grass lawn with small leaf tufts, light green; (2) smooth light grey-beige flagstone surface with faint speckles, no joints and no grout lines; (3) red clay roof tiles in overlapping scalloped rows; (4) blue-grey slate roof shingles in staggered rectangular rows. Row 2: (5) golden straw thatch; (6) plain woven canvas cloth, light cream; (7) dense rounded clumps of tree leaves, fresh green; (8) dense pine needle clusters, dark green. Row 3: (9) cartoon water surface with soft ripples and small white glints, blue; (10) packed brown dirt ground with small pebbles; (11) grey rock face with angular facets; (12) vertical brown tree bark with long grooves. Row 4: (13) soft green moss; (14) smooth cream plaster wall with subtle brush strokes, no bricks; (15) pale sandy gravel ground; (16) rounded grey cobblestones with dark brown joints. No text, no letters, no logo, no numbers. All icons, elements, and 3D texts are strictly contained inside the borders with nothing sticking out. Clean flat 2D mobile game UI asset, isolated on a solid flat white background, no external drop shadows.

Negative Prompt: realistic 3D, photorealism, plastic texture, blurry, external drop shadow, elements sticking out of frame, broken borders, cropped text, dark gloomy teal palette, square text brackets "[+]", stat progress bars, character inside portrait frame, floating map pins.
